title: Mutiny on the Bounty
summary: Fletcher Christian and part of the crew seized HMS Bounty near Tonga and set Captain William Bligh adrift with loyal men in a small boat.
reason: After months in Tahiti, the crew resented a return to harsh discipline under Bligh.
significance: Bligh's 6,700 km open boat voyage and the mutineers' settlement of Pitcairn became legendary.
